title: Children's Fairyland
specs: Whimsical 10-acre storybook park on the shores of Oakland’s Lake Merritt
Magical playsets, friendly animals, puppet shows, rides, live performances
Events including book festivals, cultural celebrations, and seasonal festivities
Designed for families with little ones (ages 0-8)
blurb: Explore magical playsets, meet friendly animals, watch puppet shows, and enjoy rides, live performances and hands-on fun in a safe, outdoor wonderland. The park has been sparking imagination and joy since 1950. It hosts various events including book festivals, cultural celebrations, and seasonal festivities.
